label: Sticker / Prop
description: The personality layer: a physical prop that sits ON other content. kind 'stamp' (rotated rubber-stamp slam, e.g. SAVE / SHIPPED), 'gesture' (a small instruction like 'Swipe up to save' -- pair with an arrow in the text), 'pill' (solid label chip, e.g. STONKS), 'ring' (a drawn circle highlighting a spot), 'image' (an ILLUSTRATED CUTOUT -- a transparent PNG sticker from generate_clip mode='cutout' -- dropping in as a physical object with a settle, optional slow swing, and comic whoosh accents; the print films' hero-prop beat). Position and size it with the component's position box. Seasoning, never the subject: 1-3 per scene max (an image prop may be the scene's visual anchor beside a headline).

text.label: The prop's text (not used for ring/image)

src.label: image only: the cutout PNG -- a REAL /assets/... URL from the film's motif assets or brand kit. NEVER cast kind='image' without one (an empty or invented src degrades to an empty pill); when no cutout asset exists, use stamp/gesture/pill/ring instead.

motion.label: image only: 'settle' (default) | 'swing' (slow residual sway, a hung object)

whoosh.label: image only: comic motion accents near the entry corner (default true)

color.label: Prop color (defaults: stamp/gesture amber, pill primary, ring green)
